name: kite
about: Red diamond paper kite with a colored tail
code:
def kite(name, loc, s=1.0):
    root = empty(name, loc)
    red = mat('kite_red', hexc('#e03a30'), 0.5)
    poly_extrude(name + '_body', [(0, 1.2), (0.8, 0), (0, -1.4), (-0.8, 0)], 0.06, (0, 0, 0), red, rot=(90, 0, 0), parent=root)
    box(name + '_spar', (0.06, 0.05, 2.6), (0, -0.07, -0.1), mat('kite_wood', hexc('#8a5a32'), 0.6), 0.01, parent=root)
    for i in range(4):
        box(name + '_tail%d' % i, (0.3, 0.04, 0.16), (0.1 * (i % 2), 0, -1.7 - i * 0.4), mat('kite_t%d' % (i % 2), hexc('#f2c14e' if i % 2 else '#4aa5e8'), 0.5), 0.01, parent=root)
    root.scale = (s, s, s)
    return root
